v1.8.5 - Valves, pilot wire and metering modules, setup guide, Eltako and TCP gateway fixes

Twenty beta builds, field tested on the Home Assistant forum and on GitHub. Radiator valves, pilot wire heating modules and metering plugs work, Add Device explains itself, and Eltako shutters, dimmers and TCP gateways behave in daily use.

### Check after updating

- **64-bit only (amd64, aarch64).** Home Assistant ended 32-bit support (armv7, armhf, i386) with release 2025.12, see their announcement [Deprecating Core and Supervised installation methods, and 32-bit systems](https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2025/05/22/deprecating-core-and-supervised-installation-methods-and-32-bit-systems/). A 32-bit installation keeps the app version it has.
- **A5-20-01 / -04 / -06 valves** read only the valve's own fields now. The temperature was a status byte before, and fields the valve never sends are gone.
- **Pilot wire modules (D2-01-0C)** lose their on/off switch; the *Pilot Wire Mode* select covers it.
- **Dimmers that were off before the update** need one on/off cycle to store their level.

### New

- **Radiator valves (A5-20-01, e.g. Micropelt MVA004)** can be set from Home Assistant.
- **Pilot wire modules (D2-01-0C)** and **metering D2-01 modules** (e.g. NodOn Micro Smart Plug) get Power and Energy.
- **Add Device explains itself**, with illustrations and a searchable list of confirmed devices.
- **Device list**: sort by name, last seen, status or room; cards or a compact list.
- **A setup guide for AI assistants** at `/api/ai/guide`.

### Fixed

- Eltako shutters taught as a pushbutton: no Stop to a shutter that stands still, and a quick second Stop no longer restarts it.
- Dimmers keep their level, also after a Home Assistant restart.
- TCP gateways that close idle connections stay connected; commands during a reconnect are no longer lost.
- Corrupted meter readings no longer reach the energy dashboard; a real counter reset still does.
- Paired D2 modules no longer share a sender ID with Eltako actuators.
- The app's own repeated telegrams are no longer listed as unknown devices, and the log is much quieter.

Base image Alpine 3.24 and Python 3.14, libraries updated, closing known security issues.

Full changelog: [addon/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ESDN83/HA_enoceanmqtt-addon-ui/blob/main/addon/CHANGELOG.md)

Thanks to dmutsaers, DelicateDonkey and Maxime-roche for testing and reporting.
